question: In which of the following cities were the first and second test cricket matches (2021) between India and England held?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Chennai.__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The first two Test matches of the **IND vs ENG Test series** were held at the** MA Chidambaram Stadium**, also known as Chepa
